title: वामपन्थी लुलासँग हारेपछि अमेरिकी शरणमा पुगे ब्राजिलका फ्लाभियो, ट्रम्पले के भने ?
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्पले ब्राजिलको राष्ट्रपतीय निर्वाचनमा पराजित भएका सिनेटर फ्लाभियो बोल्सोनारो अमेरिका आउन लागेको विषयमा समर्थन जनाएका छन् । बुधबार पत्रकारहरूसँग कुरा गर्दै ट्रम्पले फ्लाभियो अमेरिका आउन आफूले स्वीकृति दिने बताएका हुन् । टेक्सासको चुनावी भ्रमणबाट फर्कने क्रममा जोइन्ट बेस एन्ड्र्युजमा विमानस्थलको टारम्याकमा पत्रकारहरूसँग कुरा गर्दै उनले बोल्सोनारो अर्जेन्टिनामा रहेको सुनेको पनि बताए । समाचार संस्था रोयटर्सका अनुसार फ्लाभियो मंगलबार ब्राजिल छाडेर अमेरिका गएका थिए । अमेरिकी विदेश मन्त्रालयका एक वरिष्ठ अधिकारीले उनलाई र उनको परिवारलाई अमेरिका प्रवेशका लागि भिसा उपलब्ध गराइने बताएका थिए । वर्तमान वामपन्थी राष्ट्रपति लुइज इनासियो लुला दा सिल्भासँगको निर्वाचनमा पराजित भए पनि फ्लाभियोले आफ्नो हार स्वीकार गरेका छैनन् । सर्वोच्च अदालतको राहदानी बुझाउनुपर्ने आदेश पालना गर्न अस्वीकार गरेपछि उनले ब्राजिल छाडेका हुन् । ‘मलाई लाग्छ, उनीहरू असल मानिस हुन्,’ ट्रम्पले भने, ‘निर्वाचन निकै अनौठो थियो र मलाई यो निकै खराब लाग्यो । यसको नतिजाबारे राम्रो प्रतिक्रिया आएको छैन । त्यहाँको बजारमा के भयो भनेर हेर्नुहोस् ।’ उनले निर्वाचनका क्रममा आफूले कुनै पक्ष नलिएको पनि स्पष्ट पारे । ‘यस्तो अवस्था देख्नु निकै दुःखद् छ । मैले कुनै पक्ष लिइनँ । म उनीहरू दुवैलाई चिन्छु । लुलालाई चिन्छु र फ्लाभियोलाई पनि केही हदसम्म चिन्छु। उनका बुबालाई भने राम्ररी चिन्छु,’ ट्रम्पले भने । ट्रम्पले फ्लाभियोका बुबा तथा ब्राजिलका पूर्वराष्ट्रपति जैर बोल्सोनारोको प्रसङ्गसमेत उल्लेख गरे । उनले जैरलाई ब्राजिलमा न्यायिक प्रताडना गरिएको आरोप लगाउँदै आएका छन् । ‘उनका बुबासँग निकै नराम्रो व्यवहार गरिएको थियो भन्ने मलाई लागेको थियो । तर, म त्यसमा संलग्न थिइनँ। त्यो ब्राजिलको कुरा हो, त्यो फरक देश हो,’ ट्रम्पले भने । पुटिन र जेलेन्स्कीसँग भेट्ने ट्रम्पको इच्छा यसैबीच, ट्रम्पले रुसका राष्ट्रपति भ्लादिमिर पुटिन र युक्रेनका राष्ट्रपति भोलोदिमिर जेलेन्स्कीसँग छिट्टै भेट्ने आशा व्यक्त गरेका छन् । उनले युक्रेन युद्ध अन्त्य गर्ने दिशामा उल्लेख्य प्रगति भएको आफ्नो धारणा पनि राखे । पुटिनले आगामी महिना अमेरिकाको मध्यस्थतामा युक्रेनसँग वार्ता पुनः सुरु गर्न रुस तयार रहेको बताएका छन् । उनले दुवै देशका लागि सुरक्षा प्रत्याभूति र समग्र युरोपका लागि सुरक्षा संरचना निर्माण गर्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिएका छन् । ट्रम्पले चिनियाँ राष्ट्रपति सी जिनपिङसँग आणविक हतियार निःशस्त्रीकरणसम्बन्धी बैठकसमेत तय भएको जानकारी दिए । साथै, उनी नोभेम्बरमा दक्षिणपूर्वी एसियाली राष्ट्रहरूको सङ्गठन (आसियान)को शिखर सम्मेलनमा सहभागी हुन फिलिपिन्सको राजधानी मनिला जाने कार्यक्रम छ । नेतन्याहुको चुनावी नतिजाबारे ट्रम्पको टिप्पणी इजरायलमा भएको निर्वाचनमा प्रधानमन्त्री बेन्जामिन नेतन्याहुको पार्टीले सिट गुमाएको विषयमा सोधिएको प्रश्नमा ट्रम्पले नेतन्याहुले राम्रो प्रदर्शन गरेको US President Donald Trump has expressed support for Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, who was defeated in the Brazilian presidential election, to visit the United States. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, Trump said he would allow Flavio to come to the United States. Speaking to reporters on the airport tarmac at Joint Base Andrews on his way back from a campaign trip to Texas, he also said he had heard that Bolsonaro was in Argentina. According to Reuters, Flavio left Brazil for the United States on Tuesday. A senior US State Department official said he and his family would be granted visas to enter the United States. Despite losing the election to current leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Flavio has not accepted his defeat. He left Brazil after refusing to comply with a Supreme Court order to surrender his passport. "I think they're good people," Trump said. "The election was very strange and I thought it was very bad. The reaction to the results was not good. Look at what happened in the markets there." He also made it clear that he did not take sides in the election. "It's very sad to see this situation. I did not take sides. I know both of them. I know Lula and I know Flavio to some extent. I know his father very well," Trump said. Trump also mentioned Flavio's father and former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, who he has accused of judicial harassment in Brazil. "I thought his father was treated very badly. But I wasn't involved in that. That's Brazil, that's a different country," Trump said. Trump's desire to meet with Putin and Zelensky Meanwhile, Trump expressed hope to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky soon, adding that he believes significant progress has been made towards ending the war in Ukraine. Putin has said Russia is ready to resume talks with Ukraine next month under US mediation. He has stressed the need for security guarantees for both countries and the creation of a security architecture for Europe as a whole. Trump also said he is scheduled to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping on nuclear disarmament. He is also scheduled to travel to Manila, the capital of the Philippines, in November to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit. Trump's comments on Netanyahu's election results Asked about Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party losing seats in the Israeli election, Trump said he had heard Netanyahu was doing well. "From what I hear, he did very well. The results are very competitive, which is a good thing," Trump said. Claiming that his support for Netanyahu had helped him greatly, Trump said the result could be a win or a tie. Meanwhile, the US is holding midterm elections next week. Various polls have shown that President Trump's Republican Party could lose control of one or both houses of Congress.

US President Donald Trump has expressed support for Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, who was defeated in the Brazilian presidential election, to visit the United States. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, Trump said he would allow Flavio to come to the United States. Speaking to reporters on the airport tarmac at Joint Base Andrews on his way back from a campaign trip to Texas, he also said he had heard that Bolsonaro was in Argentina. According to Reuters, Flavio left Brazil for the United States on Tuesday. A senior US State Department official said he and his family would be granted visas to enter the United States. Despite losing the election to current leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Flavio has not accepted his defeat. He left Brazil after refusing to comply with a Supreme Court order to surrender his passport. "I think they're good people," Trump said. "The election was very strange and I thought it was very bad. The reaction to the results was not good. Look at what happened in the markets there." He also made it clear that he did not take sides in the election. "It's very sad to see this situation. I did not take sides. I know both of them. I know Lula and I know Flavio to some extent. I know his father very well," Trump said. Trump also mentioned Flavio's father and former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, who he has accused of judicial harassment in Brazil. "I thought his father was treated very badly. But I wasn't involved in that. That's Brazil, that's a different country," Trump said. Trump's desire to meet with Putin and Zelensky Meanwhile, Trump expressed hope to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky soon, adding that he believes significant progress has been made towards ending the war in Ukraine. Putin has said Russia is ready to resume talks with Ukraine next month under US mediation. He has stressed the need for security guarantees for both countries and the creation of a security architecture for Europe as a whole. Trump also said he is scheduled to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping on nuclear disarmament. He is also scheduled to travel to Manila, the capital of the Philippines, in November to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit. Trump's comments on Netanyahu's election results Asked about Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party losing seats in the Israeli election, Trump said he had heard Netanyahu was doing well. "From what I hear, he did very well. The results are very competitive, which is a good thing," Trump said. Claiming that his support for Netanyahu had helped him greatly, Trump said the result could be a win or a tie. Meanwhile, the US is holding midterm elections next week. Various polls have shown that President Trump's Republican Party could lose control of one or both houses of Congress.

US President Donald Trump has expressed support for Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, who was defeated in the Brazilian presidential election, to visit the United States. Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, Trump said he would allow Flavio to come to the United States. Speaking to reporters on the airport tarmac at Joint Base Andrews on his way back from a campaign trip to Texas, he also said he had heard that Bolsonaro was in Argentina. According to Reuters, Flavio left Brazil for the United States on Tuesday. A senior US State Department official said he and his family would be granted visas to enter the United States. Despite losing the election to current leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Flavio has not accepted his defeat. He left Brazil after refusing to comply with a Supreme Court order to surrender his passport. "I think they're good people," Trump said. "The election was very strange and I thought it was very bad. I did not take sides. I know both of them. I know Lula and I know Flavio to some extent. I know his father very well," Trump said. Trump also mentioned Flavio's father and former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, who he has accused of judicial harassment in Brazil. "I thought his father was treated very badly. Putin has said Russia is ready to resume talks with Ukraine next month under US mediation. He has stressed the need for security guarantees for both countries and the creation of a security architecture for Europe as a whole. Trump also said he is scheduled to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping on nuclear disarmament. He is also scheduled to travel to Manila, the capital of the Philippines, in November to attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit. Trump's comments on Netanyahu's election results Asked about Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's party losing seats in the Israeli election, Trump said he had heard Netanyahu was doing well. Claiming that his support for Netanyahu had helped him greatly, Trump said the result could be a win or a tie. Meanwhile, the US is holding midterm elections next week. Various polls have shown that President Trump's Republican Party could lose control of one or both houses of Congress.

उनले निर्वाचनका क्रममा आफूले कुनै पक्ष नलिएको पनि स्पष्ट पारे । ‘यस्तो अवस्था देख्नु निकै दुःखद् छ । मैले कुनै पक्ष लिइनँ । म उनीहरू दुवैलाई चिन्छु । लुलालाई चिन्छु र फ्लाभियोलाई पनि केही हदसम्म चिन्छु। उनका बुबालाई भने राम्ररी चिन्छु,’ ट्रम्पले भने ।

ट्रम्पले फ्लाभियोका बुबा तथा ब्राजिलका पूर्वराष्ट्रपति जैर बोल्सोनारोको प्रसङ्गसमेत उल्लेख गरे । उनले जैरलाई ब्राजिलमा न्यायिक प्रताडना गरिएको आरोप लगाउँदै आएका छन् ।

‘उनका बुबासँग निकै नराम्रो व्यवहार गरिएको थियो भन्ने मलाई लागेको थियो । तर, म त्यसमा संलग्न थिइनँ। त्यो ब्राजिलको कुरा हो, त्यो फरक देश हो,’ ट्रम्पले भने ।

पुटिन र जेलेन्स्कीसँग भेट्ने ट्रम्पको इच्छा

यसैबीच, ट्रम्पले रुसका राष्ट्रपति भ्लादिमिर पुटिन र युक्रेनका राष्ट्रपति भोलोदिमिर जेलेन्स्कीसँग छिट्टै भेट्ने आशा व्यक्त गरेका छन् । उनले युक्रेन युद्ध अन्त्य गर्ने दिशामा उल्लेख्य प्रगति भएको आफ्नो धारणा पनि राखे ।

पुटिनले आगामी महिना अमेरिकाको मध्यस्थतामा युक्रेनसँग वार्ता पुनः सुरु गर्न रुस तयार रहेको बताएका छन् । उनले दुवै देशका लागि सुरक्षा प्रत्याभूति र समग्र युरोपका लागि सुरक्षा संरचना निर्माण गर्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिएका छन् ।

ट्रम्पले चिनियाँ राष्ट्रपति सी जिनपिङसँग आणविक हतियार निःशस्त्रीकरणसम्बन्धी बैठकसमेत तय भएको जानकारी दिए । साथै, उनी नोभेम्बरमा दक्षिणपूर्वी एसियाली राष्ट्रहरूको सङ्गठन (आसियान)को शिखर सम्मेलनमा सहभागी हुन फिलिपिन्सको राजधानी मनिला जाने कार्यक्रम छ ।

नेतन्याहुको चुनावी नतिजाबारे ट्रम्पको टिप्पणी

इजरायलमा भएको निर्वाचनमा प्रधानमन्त्री बेन्जामिन नेतन्याहुको पार्टीले सिट गुमाएको विषयमा सोधिएको प्रश्नमा ट्रम्पले नेतन्याहुले राम्रो प्रदर्शन गरेको आफूले सुनेको बताए ।

‘मैले सुनेअनुसार उनले निकै राम्रो गरे। नतिजा निकै प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक छ, जुन राम्रो कुरा हो,’ ट्रम्पले भने ।

आफूले नेतन्याहुलाई दिएको समर्थनले उनलाई निकै सहयोग पुगेको दाबी गर्दै ट्रम्पले नतिजा जित वा बराबरी हुन सक्ने बताए ।

यसैबीच, अमेरिकामा आगामी साता मध्यावधि निर्वाचन हुँदैछ । विभिन्न सर्वेक्षणले राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्पको रिपब्लिकन पार्टीले संसद्का एक वा दुवै सदनमा नियन्त्रण गुमाउन सक्ने सम्भावना देखाएका छन् ।
